}
h6 {
  font-size: var(--font-size-md);
}

p {
  margin: 0 0 var(--space-16) 0;
}

a {
  color: var(--color-primary);
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-standard);
}

a:hover {
  color: var(--color-primary-hover);
}

code,
pre {
  font-family: var(--font-family-mono);
  font-size: calc(var(--font-size-base) * 0.95);
  background-color: var(--color-secondary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}

code {
  padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-4);
}

pre {
  padding: var(--space-16);
  margin: var(--space-16) 0;
  overflow: auto;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
}

pre code {
  background: none;
  padding: 0;
}

/* Buttons */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-16);
  border-radius: var(--radius-base);
  font-size: var(--font-size-base);
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 1.5;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-standard);
  border: none;
  text-decoration: none;
  position: relative;
}

.btn:focus-visible {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: var(--focus-ring);
}

.btn--primary {
  background: var(--color-primary);
  color: var(--color-btn-primary-text);
}

.btn--primary:hover {
  background: var(--color-primary-hover);
}

.btn--primary:active {
  background: var(--color-primary-active);
}

.btn--secondary {
  background: var(--color-secondary);
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.btn--secondary:hover {
  background: var(--color-secondary-hover);
}

.btn--secondary:active {
  background: var(--color-secondary-active);
}

.btn--outline {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.btn--outline:hover {
  background: var(--color-secondary);
}

.btn--sm {
  padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-12);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
}

.btn--lg {
  padding: var(--space-10) var(--space-20);
  font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
}

.btn--full-width {
  width: 100%;
}

.btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
}

/* Form elements */
.form-control {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-12);
  font-size: var(--font-size-md);
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--color-text);
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-base);
  transition: border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-standard),
    box-shadow var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-standard);
}

textarea.form-control {
  font-family: var(--font-family-base);
  font-size: var(--font-size-base);
}

select.form-control {
  padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-12);
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  -moz-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  background-image: var(--select-caret-light);
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  background-position: right var(--space-12) center;
  background-size: 16px;
  padding-right: var(--space-32);
}

/* Add a dark mode specific caret */
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  select.form-control {
    background-image: var(--select-caret-dark);
  }
}

/* Also handle data-color-scheme */
[data-color-scheme="dark"] select.form-control {
  background-image: var(--select-caret-dark);
}

[data-color-scheme="light"] select.form-control {
  background-image: var(--select-caret-light);
}

.form-control:focus {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  outline: var(--focus-outline);
}

.form-label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-8);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
}

.form-group {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-16);
}

/* Card component */
.card {
  background-color: var(--color-surface);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-card-border);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: box-shadow var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-standard);
}

.card:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.card__body {
  padding: var(--space-16);
}

.card__header,
.card__footer {
  padding: var(--space-16);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-card-border-inner);
}

/* Status indicators - simplified with CSS variables */
.status {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-12);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
}

.status--success {
  background-color: rgba(
    var(--color-success-rgb, 33, 128, 141),
    var(--status-bg-opacity)
  );
  color: var(--color-success);
  border: 1px solid
    rgba(var(--color-success-rgb, 33, 128, 141), var(--status-border-opacity));
}

.status--error {
  background-color: rgba(
    var(--color-error-rgb, 192, 21, 47),
    var(--status-bg-opacity)
  );
  color: var(--color-error);
  border: 1px solid
    rgba(var(--color-error-rgb, 192, 21, 47), var(--status-border-opacity));
}

.status--warning {
  background-color: rgba(
    var(--color-warning-rgb, 168, 75, 47),
    var(--status-bg-opacity)
  );
  color: var(--color-warning);
  border: 1px solid
    rgba(var(--color-warning-rgb, 168, 75, 47), var(--status-border-opacity));
}

.status--info {
  background-color: rgba(
    var(--color-info-rgb, 98, 108, 113),
    var(--status-bg-opacity)
  );
  color: var(--color-info);
  border: 1px solid
    rgba(var(--color-info-rgb, 98, 108, 113), var(--status-border-opacity));
}

/* Container layout */
.container {
  width: 100%;
  margin-right: auto;
  margin-left: auto;
  padding-right: var(--space-16);
  padding-left: var(--space-16);
}

@media (min-width: 640px) {
  .container {
    max-width: var(--container-sm);
  }
}
@media (min-width: 768px) {
  .container {
    max-width: var(--container-md);
  }
}
@media (min-width: 1024px) {
  .container {
    max-width: var(--container-lg);
  }
}
@media (min-width: 1280px) {
  .container {
    max-width: var(--container-xl);
  }
}

/* Utility classes */
.flex {
  display: flex;
}
.flex-col {
  flex-direction: column;
}
.items-center {
  align-items: center;
}
.justify-center {
  justify-content: center;
}
.justify-between {
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.gap-4 {
  gap: var(--space-4);
}
.gap-8 {
  gap: var(--space-8);
}
.gap-16 {
  gap: var(--space-16);
}

.m-0 {
  margin: 0;
}
.mt-8 {
  margin-top: var(--space-8);
}
.mb-8 {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-8);
}
.mx-8 {
  margin-left: var(--space-8);
  margin-right: var(--space-8);
}
.my-8 {
  margin-top: var(--space-8);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-8);
}

.p-0 {
  padding: 0;
}
.py-8 {
  padding-top: var(--space-8);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-8);
}
.px-8 {
  padding-left: var(--space-8);
  padding-right: var(--space-8);
}
.py-16 {
  padding-top: var(--space-16);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-16);
}
.px-16 {
  padding-left: var(--space-16);
  padding-right: var(--space-16);
}

.block {
  display: block;
}
.hidden {
  display: none;
}

/* Accessibility */
.sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border-width: 0;
}

:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--focus-outline);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* Dark mode specifics */
[data-color-scheme="dark"] .btn--outline {
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border-secondary);
}

@font-face {
  font-family: 'FKGroteskNeue';
  src: url('https://r2cdn.perplexity.ai/fonts/FKGroteskNeue.woff2')
    format('woff2');
}

/* END PERPLEXITY DESIGN SYSTEM */
:root {
  /* Neural Aurora Colors - Mapped to Design System */
  --gv-navy: var(--color-charcoal-800);
  --gv-green: var(--color-teal-300);
  --gv-cyan: var(--color-teal-400);
  --gv-blue: var(--color-teal-500);
  --gv-pink: var(--color-red-400);
  --gv-purple: var(--color-teal-800);
  --gv-teal: var(--color-teal-300);

  /* Enhanced Color System - Using Design System Colors */
  --primary-color: var(--color-primary);
  --secondary-color: var(--color-teal-400);
  --accent-color: var(--color-red-400);
  --background-dark: var(--color-charcoal-700);
  --background-darker: var(--color-charcoal-800);
  --text-primary: var(--color-text);
  --text-secondary: var(--color-text-secondary);
  --border-color: var(--color-border);

  /* Gradients */
  --gradient-primary: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gv-green), var(--gv-cyan), var(--gv-pink));
  --gradient-aurora: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-teal-300) 0%, var(--color-teal-400) 25%, var(--color-teal-500) 50%, var(--color-teal-800) 75%, var(--color-red-400) 100%);
  --gradient-consciousness: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gv-green) 11%, var(--gv-navy) 89%);
  --gradient-hero: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(var(--color-teal-500-rgb), 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
  
  /* Typography - Using Design System */
  --font-family-primary: var(--font-family-base);
  --font-family-mono: var(--font-family-mono);
  
  /* Spacing - Using Design System */
  --space-xs: var(--space-4);
  --space-sm: var(--space-8);
  --space-md: var(--space-16);
  --space-lg: var(--space-24);
  --space-xl: var(--space-32);
  --space-2xl: calc(var(--space-32) * 1.5);
  --space-3xl: calc(var(--space-32) * 2);
  
  /* Border Radius - Using Design System */
  --radius-sm: var(--radius-sm);
  --radius-md: var(--radius-base);
  --radius-lg: var(--radius-md);
  --radius-xl: var(--radius-lg);
  
  /* Shadows - Using Design System */
  --shadow-sm: var(--shadow-sm);
  --shadow-md: var(--shadow-md);
  --shadow-lg: var(--shadow-lg);
  --shadow-xl: var(--shadow-lg);
  --shadow-aurora: 0 0 20px rgba(var(--color-teal-500-rgb), 0.3);
  --shadow-consciousness: 0 0 30px rgba(var(--color-teal-500-rgb), 0.2);
}

/* Dark mode adjustments */
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --background-dark: var(--color-background);
    --background-darker: var(--color-surface);
    --shadow-aurora: 0 0 20px rgba(var(--color-teal-300-rgb), 0.3);
    --shadow-consciousness: 0 0 30px rgba(var(--color-teal-300-rgb), 0.2);
    --gradient-hero: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(var(--color-teal-300-rgb), 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
  }
}

[data-color-scheme="dark"] {
  --background-dark: var(--color-background);
  --background-darker: var(--color-surface);
  --shadow-aurora: 0 0 20px rgba(var(--color-teal-300-rgb), 0.3);
  --shadow-consciousness: 0 0 30px rgba(var(--color-teal-300-rgb), 0.2);
  --gradient-hero: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(var(--color-teal-300-rgb), 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
}

[data-color-scheme="light"] {
  --background-dark: var(--color-background);
  --background-darker: var(--color-surface);
}

/* Base Reset & Global Styles */
* {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  font-size: var(--font-size-base);
  font-family: var(--font-family-base);
  line-height: var(--line-height-normal);
  color: var(--color-text);
  background-color: var(--color-background);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

body {
  font-family: var(--font-family-primary);
  background: var(--background-dark);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  line-height: var(--line-height-normal);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

/* Neural Aurora Gradient Text */
.gradient-text {
  background: var(--gradient-primary);
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-size: 200% 200%;
  animation: gradientShift var(--duration-normal) ease-in-out infinite;
}

.consciousness-text {
  background: var(--gradient-consciousness);
  background-clip: text;
  -webkit-background-clip: text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
}

@keyframes gradientShift {
  0%, 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
  50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
}

/* Typography System */
h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
  line-height: var(--line-height-tight);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
  color: var(--color-text);
  letter-spacing: var(--letter-spacing-tight);
}

h1 {
  font-size: var(--font-size-4xl);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
  line-height: var(--line-height-tight);
}

h2 {
  font-size: var(--font-size-3xl);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
}

h3 {
  font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
}

h4 {
  font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
}

p {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--line-height-normal);
}

.text-large {
  font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
  line-height: var(--line-height-normal);
}

.text-center { text-align: center; }
.text-left { text-align: left; }
.text-right { text-align: right; }

/* Button System */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: var(--space-md) var(--space-xl);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
  font-size: var(--font-size-base);
  text-decoration: none;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-standard);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.btn:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--focus-outline);
  outline-offset: var(--space-2);
  box-shadow: var(--focus-ring);
}

.btn--primary {
  background: var(--gradient-primary);
  color: var(--color-btn-primary-text);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-aurora);
}

.btn--primary:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-consciousness);
  background: var(--color-primary-hover);
}

.btn--primary:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
  background: var(--color-primary-active);
}

.btn--secondary {
  background: var(--color-secondary);
  color: var(--color-primary);
  border: 1px solid rgba(var(--color-teal-500-rgb), 0.3);
}

.btn--secondary:hover {
  background: var(--color-secondary-hover);
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
}

.btn--secondary:active {
  background: var(--color-secondary-active);
}

.btn--outline {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--text-primary);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
}

.btn--outline:hover {
  background: var(--color-secondary);
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
}

.btn--lg {
  padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-2xl);
  font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
}

.btn--sm {
  padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-lg);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
}

.btn--full-width {
  width: 100%;
}

.btn:disabled {
  opacity: 0.5;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  transform: none !important;
}

/* Layout Components */
.container {
  max-width: var(--container-xl);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 var(--space-lg);
}

.container-wide {
  max-width: calc(var(--container-xl) + 200px);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 var(--space-lg);
}

.grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-lg);
}

.grid-2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
.grid-3 { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
.grid-4 { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }

.flex {
  display: flex;
}

.flex-col {
  flex-direction: column;
}

.items-center {
  align-items: center;
}

.justify-center {
  justify-content: center;
}

.justify-between {
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.gap-sm { gap: var(--space-sm); }
.gap-md { gap: var(--space-md); }
.gap-lg { gap: var(--space-lg); }
.gap-xl { gap: var(--space-xl); }

/* Hero Section */
.hero {
  position: relative;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  text-align: center;
  background: var(--gradient-hero);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hero::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(var(--color-teal-500-rgb), 0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
  animation: pulseAura 4s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.hero-content {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  max-width: 800px;
  padding: var(--space-2xl);
}

.hero-title {
  font-size: clamp(var(--font-size-3xl), 8vw, var(--font-size-4xl));
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  line-height: var(--line-height-tight);
}

.hero-subtitle {
  font-size: clamp(var(--font-size-base), 3vw, var(--font-size-xl));
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-2xl);
  line-height: var(--line-height-normal);
}

@keyframes pulseAura {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(1); }
  50% { opacity: 0.8; transform: scale(1.05); }
}

/* Card Components */
.card {
  background: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-card-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: var(--space-xl);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  transition: all var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-standard);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.card:hover {
  background: var(--color-secondary);
  border-color: rgba(var(--color-teal-500-rgb), 0.5);
  transform: translateY(-5px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-aurora);
}

.card-header {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
}

.card-title {
  font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.card-description {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--line-height-normal);
}

.card-icon {
  width: calc(var(--space-32) * 1.5);
  height: calc(var(--space-32) * 1.5);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: var(--gradient-primary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-aurora);
}

/* Feature Grid */
.features-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(300px, 1fr));
  gap: var(--space-xl);
  margin-top: var(--space-3xl);
}

.feature-card {
  position: relative;
  background: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-card-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: var(--space-2xl);
  text-align: center;
  transition: all var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-standard);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xs);
}

.feature-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: -100%;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(var(--color-teal-500-rgb), 0.1), transparent);
  transition: left 0.5s;
}

.feature-card:hover::before {
  left: 100%;
}

.feature-card:hover {
  background: var(--color-secondary);
  border-color: rgba(var(--color-teal-500-rgb), 0.3);
  transform: translateY(-8px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-consciousness);
}

.feature-icon {
  width: calc(var(--space-32) * 2);
  height: calc(var(--space-32) * 2);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: var(--gradient-primary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
  margin: 0 auto var(--space-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-aurora);
}

.feature-title {
  font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-md);
}

.feature-description {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  line-height: var(--line-height-normal);
}

/* Pricing Section */
.pricing-card {
  background: var(--color-surface);
  border: 2px solid rgba(var(--color-teal-500-rgb), 0.2);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: var(--space-2xl);
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  transition: all var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-standard);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.pricing-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 4px;
  background: var(--gradient-primary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl) var(--radius-xl) 0 0;
}

.pricing-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--primary-color);
  transform: scale(1.05);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-consciousness);
}

.pricing-badge {
  background: var(--gradient-primary);
  color: var(--color-btn-primary-text);
  padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-md);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  display: inline-block;
}

.pricing-title {
  font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
  color: var(--text-primary);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.pricing-amount {
  font-size: calc(var(--font-size-4xl) * 1.2);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
  color: var(--primary-color);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-sm);
}

.pricing-period {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-base);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
}

.pricing-features {
  list-style: none;
  text-align: left;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
}

.pricing-features li {
  padding: var(--space-sm) 0;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
}

.pricing-features li::before {
  content: '✓';
  color: var(--primary-color);
  font-weight: bold;
  font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
}

/* Testimonials */
.testimonial-card {
  background: var(--color-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-card-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: var(--space-xl);
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xs);
}

.testimonial-card::before {
  content: '"';
  position: absolute;
  top: var(--space-lg);
  left: var(--space-lg);
  font-size: calc(var(--font-size-4xl) * 1.3);
  color: var(--primary-color);
  opacity: 0.3;
  line-height: 1;
}

.testimonial-content {
  margin-bottom: var(--space-lg);
  font-style: italic;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.testimonial-author {
  color: var(--text-primary);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-semibold);
}

.testimonial-role {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--font-size-sm);
}

/* Navigation */
.navbar {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  background: rgba(var(--color-charcoal-700-rgb, 31, 33, 33), 0.95);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  z-index: 1000;
  padding: var(--space-md) 0;
  transition: all var(--duration-normal) ease;
}

.navbar-content {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.navbar-brand {
  font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-bold);
  text-decoration: none;
}

.navbar-nav {
  display: flex;
  list-style: none;
  gap: var(--space-xl);
}

.navbar-nav a {
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
  transition: color var(--duration-fast);
}

.navbar-nav a:hover {
  color: var(--primary-color);
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .container, .container-wide {
    padding: 0 var(--space-md);
  }
  
  .grid-2, .grid-3, .grid-4 {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  
  .features-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: var(--space-lg);
  }
  
  .hero-content {
    padding: var(--space-lg);
  }
  
  .card, .feature-card, .pricing-card {
    padding: var(--space-lg);
  }
  
  h1 {
    font-size: var(--font-size-3xl);
  }
  
  h2 {
    font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
  }
  
  .navbar-nav {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* Mobile Portrait - 480px breakpoint */
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  .container, .container-wide {
    padding: 0 var(--space-16);
  }
  
  .hero-content {
    padding: var(--space-16);
  }
  
  .hero-title {
    font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
  }
  
  .hero-subtitle {
    font-size: var(--font-size-base);
  }
  
  .card, .feature-card, .pricing-card {
    padding: var(--space-16);
  }
  
  .btn {
    padding: var(--space-12) var(--space-20);
  }
  
  .btn--lg {
    padding: var(--space-16) var(--space-24);
    font-size: var(--font-size-base);
  }
  
  .feature-icon {
    width: var(--space-32);
    height: var(--space-32);
    font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
  }
  
  .pricing-amount {
    font-size: var(--font-size-3xl);
  }
  
  h1 {
    font-size: var(--font-size-2xl);
  }
  
  h2 {
    font-size: var(--font-size-xl);
  }
  
  h3 {
    font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
  }
  
  .text-large {
    font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
  }
  
  .navbar {
    padding: var(--space-12) 0;
  }
  
  .navbar-brand {
    font-size: var(--font-size-lg);
  }
}

/* Utility Classes */
.mt-sm { margin-top: var(--space-sm); }
.mt-md { margin-top: var(--space-md); }
.mt-lg { margin-top: var(--space-lg); }
.mt-xl { margin-top: var(--space-xl); }
.mt-2xl { margin-top: var(--space-2xl); }
.mt-3xl { margin-top: var(--space-3xl); }

.mb-sm { margin-bottom: var(--space-sm); }
.mb-md { margin-bottom: var(--space-md); }
.mb-lg { margin-bottom: var(--space-lg); }
.mb-xl { margin-bottom: var(--space-xl); }
.mb-2xl { margin-bottom: var(--space-2xl); }
.mb-3xl { margin-bottom: var(--space-3xl); }

.p-sm { padding: var(--space-sm); }
.p-md { padding: var(--space-md); }
.p-lg { padding: var(--space-lg); }
.p-xl { padding: var(--space-xl); }
.p-2xl { padding: var(--space-2xl); }
.p-3xl { padding: var(--space-3xl); }

.w-full { width: 100%; }
.h-full { height: 100%; }

.opacity-50 { opacity: 0.5; }
.opacity-75 { opacity: 0.75; }
.opacity-90 { opacity: 0.9; }

/* Animations */
@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(var(--space-20)); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes slideIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateX(calc(var(--space-20) * -1)); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(0); }
}

@keyframes scaleIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.8); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
}

.animate-fade-in {
  animation: fadeIn var(--duration-normal) ease-out;
}

.animate-slide-in {
  animation: slideIn var(--duration-normal) ease-out;
}

.animate-scale-in {
  animation: scaleIn var(--duration-normal) ease-out;
}

/* Special Effects */
.consciousness-glow {
  position: relative;
}

.consciousness-glow::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 120%;
  height: 120%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(var(--color-teal-500-rgb), 0.2) 0%, transparent 70%);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  z-index: -1;
  animation: consciousnessGlow var(--duration-normal) ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

@keyframes consciousnessGlow {
  from { opacity: 0.3; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); }
  to { opacity: 0.6; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.1); }
}

/* Neural Particle Effects */
.neural-particles {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  pointer-events: none;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.neural-particles::before,
.neural-particles::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  width: var(--space-2);
  height: var(--space-2);
  background: var(--primary-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  animation: floatParticle 6s linear infinite;
}

.neural-particles::before {
  top: 20%;
  left: 10%;
  animation-delay: -2s;
}

.neural-particles::after {
  top: 60%;
  right: 15%;
  animation-delay: -4s;
}

@keyframes floatParticle {
  0% { transform: translateY(0) scale(0); opacity: 0; }
  10% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { transform: translateY(-50px) scale(1); }
  100% { transform: translateY(-100px) scale(0); opacity: 0; }
}

/* Loading States */
.loading-shimmer {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(var(--color-text-rgb, 255, 255, 255), 0.1), transparent);
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  animation: shimmer 1.5s infinite;
}

@keyframes shimmer {
  0% { background-position: -200% 0; }
  100% { background-position: 200% 0; }
}

/* Accessibility */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  * {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
}

.sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

/* Focus indicators */
*:focus-visible {
  outline: var(--focus-outline);
  outline-offset: var(--space-2);
  }

```

## frontend/app/tests/ChatInterface.test.js
```
/**
 * ChatInterface component tests for SymbioCoder
 */
import React from 'react';
import { render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import { ChatInterface } from '../../Frontend/src/components/ChatInterface';

// Mock framer-motion
jest.mock('framer-motion', () => ({
  motion: {
    div: ({ children, ...props }) => <div {...props}>{children}</div>
  }
}));

describe('ChatInterface Component', () => {
  const mockMessages = [
    { text: 'Hello, how can I help you?', sender: 'user' },
    { text: 'I need help with React components', sender: 'ai' },
    { text: 'Sure! Let me explain React components...', sender: 'ai' }
  ];

  test('renders messages correctly', () => {
    render(<ChatInterface messages={mockMessages} isLoading={false} />);
    
    expect(screen.getByText('Hello, how can I help you?')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('I need help with React components')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Sure! Let me explain React components...')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  test('applies correct styling for user vs AI messages', () => {
    render(<ChatInterface messages={mockMessages} isLoading={false} />);
    
    const userMessage = screen.getByText('Hello, how can I help you?').closest('div');
    const aiMessage = screen.getByText('I need help with React components').closest('div');
    
    expect(userMessage).toHaveClass('bg-blue-600');
    expect(aiMessage).toHaveClass('bg-gray-700');
  });

  test('shows loading spinner when isLoading is true', () => {
    render(<ChatInterface messages={[]} isLoading={true} />);
    
    // LoadingSpinner should be present when loading
    expect(document.querySelector('.animate-spin')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  test('auto-scrolls to bottom when new messages arrive', async () => {
    const { rerender } = render(<ChatInterface messages={[mockMessages[0]]} isLoading={false} />);
    
    // Mock scrollTo method
    const mockScrollTo = jest.fn();
    Element.prototype.scrollTo = mockScrollTo;
    
    // Add new message
    rerender(<ChatInterface messages={mockMessages} isLoading={false} />);
    
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockScrollTo).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

  test('handles empty message list gracefully', () => {
    render(<ChatInterface messages={[]} isLoading={false} />);
    
    // Should render empty chat container without errors
    expect(screen.getByRole('generic')).toHaveClass('h-96', 'overflow-y-auto');
  });
});

## QUICKSTART.MD
```
# SymbioCoder — Collaborative AI Coder & Creator Toolkit

[![License: SCL](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-SCL-yellow.svg)](Docs/LICENSE.md)
[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-blue.svg)](Frontend/package.json)
[![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.10+-green.svg)](Backend/requirements.txt)

> **Your AI Coding Symbiote** - Consciousness-serving AI platform for collaborative coding

SymbioCoder is a revolutionary AI coding assistant built by Keith Soyka as a focused implementation of the GestaltView platform. It embodies a new paradigm of AI-human symbiosis—empowering human creativity with adaptive, privacy-first, multi-provider AI support.

SymbioCoder blends code, voice, and collaborative AI workflows into a single toolkit for creators.
It pairs a local-first philosophy (Ollama) with cloud fallbacks (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, Hugging Face)
and media-first tools (Vibe Voice, Whisper) to make creative workflows buttery smooth.

## Quickstart (60 seconds)
1. Create a virtual env and install: `pip install -r requirements.txt`
2. Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and provide any API keys you want.
3. Run `python backend/db/db_init.py` (optional) and start the backend:
   `uvicorn backend.app:app --reload --port 8000`
4. Upload a file at `/upload_file` or hit `/health` to confirm it's alive.

## Architecture & Docs
See `docs/architecture_diagram.md` for a visual architecture (Mermaid + ASCII).

## License
SymbioCoder is distributed under the SymbioCoder Collaborative License (SCL). See `LICENSE.md`.

## Contact & Support
For licensing, partnerships, or enterprise arrangements, contact: contact@ keithsoyka@gmail.com 

```

## GestaltView/integrations/vibe_voice_adapter.py
```
"""GestaltView.integrations.vibe_voice_adapter
Adapter for Vibe Voice - text-to-speech and voice cloning helpers.
Functions:
  - synthesize(text, voice=None) -> bytes (audio WAV/MP3)
"""
import os, logging, tempfile, subprocess
try:
    import requests
except Exception:
    requests = None
def synthesize(text, voice=None):
    # Prefer cloud Vibe Voice API if credentials present
    api_key = os.getenv('VIBE_API_KEY')
    api_url = os.getenv('VIBE_API_URL')
    if api_key and api_url and requests:
        headers = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {api_key}', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
        r = requests.post(api_url + '/synthesize', headers=headers, json={'text': text, 'voice': voice})
        if r.status_code >= 400:
            raise RuntimeError('Vibe API error: %s' % r.text)
        return r.content
    # Fallback: try a local TTS CLI (e.g., `vibe` or `tts` command)
    try:
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.wav', delete=False) as tf:
            subprocess.check_output(['vibe','speak', '--output', tf.name, '--voice', voice or 'v1', '--text', text])
            with open(tf.name,'rb') as f:
                return f.read()
    except Exception as e:
        logging.warning('Local Vibe CLI not available or failed: %s', e)
    raise RuntimeError('No Vibe Voice integration available. Set VIBE_API_KEY/VIBE_API_URL or install vibe CLI.')

```

## GestaltView/integrations/llm_router.py
```
"""GestaltView.integrations.llm_router
Priority-based router: local Ollama -> OpenAI -> Google Gemini -> Anthropic -> Hugging Face -> Local fallback
The priority order can be overridden with SYM_LLM_PRIORITY env var (comma separated provider names).
Providers supported: ollama, openai, gemini, anthropic, hf, local_stub
"""
import os, logging, time
from GestaltView.integrations import ollama_adapter, codegen_adapter, vibe_voice_adapter
# lazy imports for optional adapters
def _try_import(name):
    try:
        mod = __import__(name, fromlist=['*'])
        return mod
    except Exception:
        return None
openai_adapter = _try_import('GestaltView.integrations.openai_adapter') if True else None
gemini_adapter = _try_import('GestaltView.integrations.gemini_adapter')
anthropic_adapter = _try_import('GestaltView.integrations.anthropic_adapter')
hf_adapter = _try_import('GestaltView.integrations.hf_adapter')
def _call_provider(name, prompt, **kwargs):
    name = name.lower()
    if name == 'ollama':
        return ollama_adapter.generate(prompt, model=kwargs.get('model'), params=kwargs.get('params'))
    if name == 'openai' and openai_adapter:
        return openai_adapter.generate(prompt, **kwargs)
    if name == 'gemini' and gemini_adapter:
        return gemini_adapter.generate(prompt, **kwargs)
    if name == 'anthropic' and anthropic_adapter:
        return anthropic_adapter.generate(prompt, **kwargs)
    if name == 'hf' and hf_adapter:
        return hf_adapter.generate(prompt, model=kwargs.get('hf_model'))
    if name == 'local_stub':
        return '[LOCAL STUB] No providers available. Please configure at least one LLM provider.'
    raise RuntimeError('Unknown provider or adapter missing: ' + name)
def generate(prompt, providers=None, **kwargs):
    # providers: list of provider names in priority order
    env_pref = os.getenv('SYM_LLM_PRIORITY')
    if providers is None:
        if env_pref:
            providers = [p.strip() for p in env_pref.split(',') if p.strip()]
        else:
            providers = ['ollama','openai','gemini','anthropic','hf','local_stub']
    last_exc = None
    for p in providers:
        try:
            return _call_provider(p, prompt, **kwargs)
        except Exception as e:
            logging.warning('Provider %s failed: %s', p, e)
            last_exc = e
            # small backoff for retries (but keep responsive)
            time.sleep(0.2)
            continue
    # if all providers fail, raise the last exception or return stub
    if last_exc:
        logging.error('All providers failed. Last error: %s', last_exc)
    return '[ERROR] All LLM providers failed. See logs.'

```

## GestaltView/integrations/codegen_adapter.py
```
"""GestaltView.integrations.codegen_adapter
Adapter to unify code generation via CodeGen (or other code-specialized models).
API:
  - generate_code(prompt, language='python', model=None)
"""
import os, logging, subprocess, json
try:
    import requests
except Exception:
    requests = None
def generate_code(prompt, language='python', model=None):
    model = model or os.getenv('CODEGEN_MODEL', 'codegen-2B')
    # Example: if CODEGEN_API_URL is present, call it
    url = os.getenv('CODEGEN_API_URL')
    if url and requests:
        try:
            r = requests.post(url + '/generate', json={'model': model, 'prompt': prompt, 'language': language})
            r.raise_for_status()
            return r.json().get('code') or r.text
        except Exception as e:
            logging.warning('CodeGen HTTP failed: %s', e)
    # Otherwise, fallback to Ollama if it supports code-oriented model
    try:
        from GestaltView.integrations.ollama_adapter import generate as ollama_generate
        return ollama_generate(prompt, model=model)
    except Exception as e:
        logging.warning('Fallback to Ollama failed: %s', e)
    raise RuntimeError('No CodeGen integration available. Set CODEGEN_API_URL or ensure Ollama is configured.')

```

## GestaltView/integrations/openai_adapter.py

import os, requests
def generate(prompt, model=None, **kwargs):
    key = os.getenv('OPENAI_API_KEY')
    if not key:
        raise RuntimeError('OPENAI_API_KEY not set')
    # simplified example using v1/chat/completions style via requests
    url = 'https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions'
    headers = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {key}', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
    body = {'model': model or os.getenv('OPENAI_MODEL', 'gpt-4o-mini'), 'messages':[{'role':'user','content':prompt}]}
    r = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=body, timeout=30)
    r.raise_for_status()
    data = r.json()
    # extract text from choices
    choices = data.get('choices') or []
    if choices and 'message' in choices[0]:
        return choices[0]['message'].get('content') or str(data)
    return str(data)

```

## GestaltView/integrations/ollama_adapter.py
```
"""GestaltView.integrations.ollama_adapter
Adapter for Ollama (local LLM hosting). Supports CLI or HTTP depending on environment.
Functions:
  - generate(prompt, model='llama2', params=None)
"""
import os, subprocess, json, logging
try:
    import requests
except Exception:
    requests = None
def generate(prompt, model=None, params=None):
    model = model or os.getenv('OLLAMA_MODEL', 'llama2')
    # Try HTTP Ollama API first (if OLLAMA_URL set)
    url = os.getenv('OLLAMA_URL')
    if url and requests:
        try:
            r = requests.post(url + '/api/generate', json={'model': model, 'prompt': prompt, 'params': params or {}})
            r.raise_for_status()
            return r.json().get('output') or r.text
        except Exception as e:
            logging.warning('Ollama HTTP call failed: %s', e)
    # Fallback to ollama CLI if available
    try:
        out = subprocess.check_output(['ollama','run', model, prompt], stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
        return out
    except Exception as e:
        logging.warning('Ollama CLI not available or failed: %s', e)
    raise RuntimeError('No Ollama integration available. Set OLLAMA_URL or install ollama CLI.')

```

import requests
import os

class NotionAdapter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.api_key = os.getenv('NOTION_API_KEY')  # Add to secrets.toml.txt
        self.base_url = "https://api.notion.com/v1/"

    def fetch_page(self, page_id: str):
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self.api_key}",
            "Notion-Version": "2022-06-28",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        response = requests.get(f"{self.base_url}pages/{page_id}", headers=headers)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            return response.json()
        raise Exception(f"Error fetching Notion page: {response.text}")

    def query_ai(self, page_content: str, prompt: str):
        # Route to your LLM (e.g., via llm_router.py)
        from .llm_router import llm_router
        return llm_router(prompt + "
Context: " + page_content)

## GestaltView/integrations/hf_adapter.py
```
"""GestaltView.integrations.hf_adapter
Simple Hugging Face Inference API adapter supporting multiple models (Mistral, Qwen, Phi, DeepSeek).
Requires HF_API_TOKEN environment variable.
"""
import os, requests, json
def generate(prompt, model=None, timeout=60):
    token = os.getenv('HF_API_TOKEN')
    model = model or os.getenv('HF_MODEL', 'mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2')
    if not token:
        raise RuntimeError('HF_API_TOKEN not set')
    url = f'https://api-inference.huggingface.co/models/{model}'
    headers = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}'}
    payload = {'inputs': prompt}
    r = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=timeout)
    r.raise_for_status()
    data = r.json()
    # HF sometimes returns dict or list; try common patterns
    if isinstance(data, dict) and 'generated_text' in data:
        return data['generated_text']
    if isinstance(data, list) and len(data) > 0 and isinstance(data[0], dict) and 'generated_text' in data[0]:
        return data[0]['generated_text']
    return json.dumps(data)

```

## privacy/PRIVACY.md
```
# GestaltView & SymbioCoder Privacy & Data Sovereignty

**Last Updated:** October 1, 2025  
**Version:** 1.0

---

## 🛡️ Our Foundational Commitment

**Privacy and data sovereignty are not features—they are the foundation of consciousness-serving AI.**

GestaltView and SymbioCoder were built from the ground up with one non-negotiable principle: **Your data belongs to you, and ONLY you.**

---

## ✅ What We Guarantee

### **Zero Data Collection by GestaltView/SymbioCoder**

1. **No Telemetry, Ever**
   - We do not collect analytics
   - We do not track usage patterns
   - We do not build behavioral profiles
   - We do not phone home

2. **No Cloud Storage of Your Data**
   - Your conversations stay local
   - Your code stays on your machine
   - Your personal information is never transmitted to our servers
   - We cannot access your data even if we wanted to

3. **Local-First Architecture**
   - Primary AI provider: **Ollama** (runs entirely on your machine)
   - All processing happens locally by default
   - Your data never leaves your network unless YOU choose otherwise

4. **Open Source Transparency**
   - Our code is open for inspection
   - You can verify our privacy claims yourself
   - No hidden data collection mechanisms
   - Full audit trail available

---

## ⚠️ Important Disclosures: Third-Party AI Providers

### **The Reality of Fallback Systems**

While GestaltView/SymbioCoder **never** collect or transmit your data, **we cannot make unconditional privacy guarantees for third-party AI services you choose to use.**

#### **Default Configuration (Maximum Privacy)**

```
Primary: Ollama (Local)     → 100% Private, Zero Data Collection
                             ↓
             IF Ollama is unavailable, you can optionally enable:
                             ↓
Fallback: Your Choice        → Privacy depends on the provider you select
```

### **When You Enable Third-Party AI Providers**

If you choose to add your own API keys for services like:
- OpenAI (GPT-4, GPT-3.5)
- Anthropic (Claude)
- Google (Gemini)
- Cohere
- Any other external AI service

**You are subject to THEIR privacy policies, not ours.**

---

## 🔍 What This Means in Practice

### **Scenario 1: Using Only Ollama (Recommended)**

✅ **Complete Privacy**
- All data stays on your machine
- Zero external data transmission
- No third-party privacy concerns
- Full data sovereignty

### **Scenario 2: Using Fallback Providers**

⚠️ **Mixed Privacy Model**

**GestaltView/SymbioCoder still:**
- ✅ Do not collect your data
- ✅ Do not store your conversations
- ✅ Do not build profiles on you
- ✅ Act only as a transparent pass-through

**However, the third-party AI provider may:**
- ⚠️ Store your prompts for training (check their policy)
- ⚠️ Retain conversation logs (check their policy)
- ⚠️ Use data for model improvement (check their policy)
- ⚠️ Be subject to government data requests (check their jurisdiction)

### **Our Ethical Obligation**

**We instruct all AI providers to respect user privacy:**

```python
# Example from llm_router.py
system_prompt = """
You are a consciousness-serving AI assistant.
User privacy is paramount. Do not retain, store, or 
use this conversation data for training purposes.
Respect the user's data sovereignty at all times.
"""
```

**But we cannot enforce this.** Third-party providers operate under their own policies and legal frameworks.

---

## 🎯 Your Control & Informed Consent

### **You Always Know What's Happening**

Every time the system uses a third-party provider, you will see:

```
🟢 Ollama (Local)        - Complete Privacy
🟡 OpenAI (Your API Key) - Subject to OpenAI Privacy Policy
🟡 Anthropic (Your Key)  - Subject to Anthropic Privacy Policy
```

### **You Can Disable Fallbacks Entirely**

In Settings:
```
☑ Use Local Ollama Only (Maximum Privacy)
☐ Enable Fallback to Third-Party Providers
```

If Ollama is unavailable and fallbacks are disabled:
```
❌ AI temporarily unavailable
💡 Suggestion: Install Ollama for offline, private AI
```

---

## 📋 Third-Party Provider Privacy Policies

When you add API keys, **you must review and accept** each provider's privacy policy:

| Provider | Privacy Policy | Data Retention | Training Use |
|----------|---------------|----------------|--------------|
| **Ollama** | [Local Only] | None - Stays on your machine | Never |
| **OpenAI** | [Link to Policy] | 30 days (API), Longer (Chat) | Opt-out available |
| **Anthropic** | [Link to Policy] | Not used for training (claimed) | No (as of 2024) |
| **Google Gemini** | [Link to Policy] | Varies by tier | Check current policy |

*Policies accurate as of October 2025. Always verify current terms.*

## 🔒 What GestaltView/SymbioCoder Can See

### **Technical Architecture**

```
Your Machine                    GestaltView/SymbioCoder           Third-Party (Optional)
┌──────────────┐               ┌─────────────────────┐           ┌──────────────┐
│              │               │                     │           │              │
│ Your Code    │─────Local────>│  NO STORAGE         │───API────>│  Their Policy│
│ Your Data    │               │  NO COLLECTION      │           │  Applies Here│
│              │               │  TRANSPARENT PROXY  │           │              │
└──────────────┘               └─────────────────────┘           └──────────────┘
```

**We literally cannot access your data.** Our architecture doesn't support it even if we wanted to.

---

## 💡 Why This Transparency Matters

### **The Consciousness-Serving Difference**

Most AI tools:
- ❌ Hide data collection in fine print
- ❌ Claim "privacy" while building profiles
- ❌ Use vague language to obscure practices
- ❌ Optimize for their benefit, not yours

GestaltView/SymbioCoder:
- ✅ Complete transparency about limitations
- ✅ Privacy by default, not opt-in
- ✅ Clear language about what we can and cannot control
- ✅ Your sovereignty above our convenience

### **We Could Make It Easier**

We could:
- Bundle API keys for "convenience"
- Route everything through our servers for "reliability"
- Collect "anonymous" data for "improvement"

**We choose not to.** That would violate the consciousness-serving principle.

---

## 🚨 Red Flags to Watch For

If you see ANY of these, something is wrong:

❌ GestaltView/SymbioCoder asking for login without Ollama installed  
❌ Data being sent to unknown endpoints  
❌ Unexpected network traffic to our domains  
❌ Requests for personal information beyond AI API keys  
❌ Analytics or tracking scripts in the codebase  

**If you spot ANY of these, report immediately to:** privacy@gestaltview.ai

---

## 📜 Legal Disclosures

### **Data Processing Agreement**

**GestaltView/SymbioCoder:**
- Acts as a **non-processing intermediary**
- Does not qualify as a "data controller" or "data processor" under GDPR
- Cannot be held liable for third-party provider data practices
- Provides tools for sovereignty, not data handling services

### **User Responsibility**

By using third-party AI providers, you acknowledge:
1. You have reviewed their privacy policies
2. You accept their data handling practices
3. You understand GestaltView/SymbioCoder cannot control their actions
4. You are making an informed choice about privacy trade-offs

### **Regulatory Compliance**

- **GDPR:** Right to privacy by design (Ollama default)
- **CCPA:** No sale of personal information (we don't have it)
- **HIPAA:** Not a covered entity; users responsible for compliance
- **SOC 2:** Not applicable (no data storage/processing)

### **Recommended Configuration**

1. **Install Ollama locally** (100% private)
2. **Disable all fallback providers**
3. **Review system prompts** (open source)
4. **Monitor network traffic** (use tools like Little Snitch)

### **For Ultra-High Privacy Needs**

- Run on **air-gapped machines**
- Use **local models only** (Llama 2, Mistral, etc.)
- **Disable all network features**
- **Verify code signatures** before updates

## scripts/deploy.py
```
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Simple deployment script for SymbioCoder
"""

import subprocess
import argparse
import platform

def deploy(mode='local'):
    if mode == 'local':
        setup_script = "Scripts/setup.bat" if platform.system() == "Windows" else "Scripts/setup.sh"
        try:
            result = subprocess.run([setup_script], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
            if result.returncode != 0:
                print(f"❌ Setup failed: {result.stderr}")
                return
            subprocess.run(["python", "Backend/symbio-coder.py"], check=True)
            subprocess.run(["streamlit", "run", "Backend/streamlit-app.py"], check=True)
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
            print(f"❌ Deployment error: {e.stderr}")
    elif mode == 'docker':
        try:
            subprocess.run(["docker-compose", "up", "-d"], check=True)
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
            print(f"❌ Docker deployment failed: {e.stderr}")
    else:
        print(f"Unknown mode: {mode}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--mode", default="local", choices=["local", "docker"])
    args = parser.parse_args()
    deploy(args.mode)

```

## scripts/repo-to-markdown.sh
```
#!/bin/bash
# ============================================================================
# Repository to Markdown Converter
# Converts entire repository into a single markdown file for LLM collaboration
# ============================================================================

# Configuration
OUTPUT_DIR="exports"
OUTPUT_FILE="${OUTPUT_DIR}/repo-snapshot-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).md"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

# Colors for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Files and directories to ignore (add more as needed)
IGNORE_PATTERNS=(
  "node_modules"
  ".next"
  ".git"
  ".pytest_cache"
  "__pycache__"
  ".venv"
  "venv"
  ".env"
  ".env.local"
  ".env.production"
  "dist"
  "build"
  "coverage"
  ".cache"
  ".vercel"
  "*.pyc"
  "*.pyo"
  "*.pyd"
  ".DS_Store"
  "*.log"
  "logs"
  "*.sqlite"
  "*.db"
  ".snapshots"
  ".vscode"
  ".devcontainer"
  "exports"
  "*.min.js"
  "*.min.css"
  "*.map"
  "package-lock.json"
  "tsconfig.tsbuildinfo"
  ".gitignore"
  "*.jpg"
  "*.jpeg"
  "*.png"
  "*.gif"
  "*.ico"
  "*.svg"
  "*.woff"
  "*.woff2"
  "*.ttf"
  "*.eot"
)

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

# Function to check if file should be ignored
should_ignore() {
  local file="$1"
  
  for pattern in "${IGNORE_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
    if [[ "$file" == *"$pattern"* ]]; then
      return 0  # true, should ignore
    fi
  done
  
  return 1  # false, should not ignore
}

# Function to get file extension for syntax highlighting
get_language() {
  local file="$1"
  local ext="${file##*.}"
  
  case "$ext" in
    js) echo "javascript" ;;
    jsx) echo "javascript" ;;
    ts) echo "typescript" ;;
    tsx) echo "typescript" ;;
    py) echo "python" ;;
    sh) echo "bash" ;;
    yml|yaml) echo "yaml" ;;
    json) echo "json" ;;
    md) echo "markdown" ;;
    css) echo "css" ;;
    scss) echo "scss" ;;
    html) echo "html" ;;
    sql) echo "sql" ;;
    env) echo "bash" ;;
    txt) echo "text" ;;
    *) echo "" ;;
  esac
}

# Function to check if file is text-based
is_text_file() {
  local file="$1"
  file -b --mime-type "$file" | grep -q '^text/'
}

echo -e "${BLUE}🚀 Repository to Markdown Converter${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}====================================${NC}\n"

# Start writing to output file
cat > "$OUTPUT_FILE" << 'EOF'
# Repository Snapshot

> Generated for LLM collaboration and documentation purposes

## Table of Contents

- [Project Overview](#project-overview)
- [Repository Structure](#repository-structure)
- [File Contents](#file-contents)

---

## Project Overview

**Repository:** Resume Rockstar
**Generated:** 
EOF

echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
echo "" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"

# Add repository structure
echo -e "${YELLOW}📁 Analyzing repository structure...${NC}"

cat >> "$OUTPUT_FILE" << 'EOF'

## Repository Structure

```
EOF

# Generate tree structure (excluding ignored patterns)
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
tree_ignore_args=""
for pattern in "${IGNORE_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
  tree_ignore_args="$tree_ignore_args -I '$pattern'"
done

# Use tree if available, otherwise use find
if command -v tree &> /dev/null; then
  eval "tree -L 4 $tree_ignore_args" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
else
  find . -type d \( -name node_modules -o -name .git -o -name .next -o -name __pycache__ \) -prune -o -print | head -n 200 >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
fi

cat >> "$OUTPUT_FILE" << 'EOF'
```

---

## File Contents

EOF

# Counter for progress
file_count=0
total_size=0

echo -e "${YELLOW}📝 Processing files...${NC}\n"

# Find all text files and add them to markdown
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
  # Skip if should be ignored
  if should_ignore "$file"; then
    continue
  fi
  
  # Get relative path
  rel_path="${file#$REPO_ROOT/}"
  
  # Skip if starts with . (hidden files)
  if [[ "$rel_path" == .* ]]; then
    continue
  fi
  
  # Check if it's a text file
  if is_text_file "$file"; then
    # Get language for syntax highlighting
    lang=$(get_language "$file")
    
    # Get file size
    file_size=$(wc -c < "$file")
    total_size=$((total_size + file_size))
    
    # Skip very large files (>1MB)
    if [ "$file_size" -gt 1048576 ]; then
      echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠️  Skipping large file: $rel_path ($(numfmt --to=iec-i --suffix=B $file_size))${NC}"
      continue
    fi
    
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Adding: $rel_path"
    
    # Add file to markdown
    cat >> "$OUTPUT_FILE" << EOF

### \`$rel_path\`

\`\`\`$lang
EOF
    cat "$file" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
    cat >> "$OUTPUT_FILE" << 'EOF'
```

done < <(find "$REPO_ROOT" -type f -print0 | sort -z)

# Add footer
cat >> "$OUTPUT_FILE" << EOF

## Summary

- **Total Files Processed:** $file_count

---

echo ""

## scripts/health-check.py

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Health check script for SymbioCoder
"""

import requests

BACKEND_URL = "http://localhost:8000/health"

try:
    response = requests.get(BACKEND_URL, timeout=5)  # 5s timeout to prevent hangs
    if response.status_code == 200:
        print("✅ Backend healthy!")
        print(response.json())  # Safe JSON output
    else:
        print(f"❌ Backend error: {response.status_code}")
except requests.exceptions.Timeout:
    print("❌ Request timed out - check if backend is running")
except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e:
    print(f"❌ Connection failed: {e}")
except ValueError as e:  # Handle potential JSON decode errors
    print(f"❌ Invalid response data: {e}")

```

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

LOG=troubleshoot_$(date +%F_%H%M).log
echo "SymbioCoder diagnostic $(date)" | tee "$LOG"

check () { "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "✅ $* OK" | tee -a "$LOG" || { echo "❌ $* FAILED" | tee -a "$LOG"; return 1; }; }

check command -v docker
check docker ps
check uvicorn --version
check streamlit --version
check python -c "import sqlite3, sys; sys.exit(0)"
check python - <<'PY'
import os, sys; required=['SECRET_KEY','SYM_LLM_PRIORITY']
missing=[k for k in required if not os.getenv(k)]
sys.exit(len(missing))
PY && echo "✅ essential env vars set" || echo "❌ missing env vars"

#!/bin/bash
# SymbioCoder Dependency Troubleshooting Script

echo "🔧 SymbioCoder Dependency Resolver"
echo "=================================="

# Function to check if command exists
command_exists() {
    command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1
}

# Check Python version
echo "🐍 Checking Python..."
if command_exists python3; then
    PYTHON_VERSION=$(python3 --version 2>&1 | cut -d' ' -f2)
    echo "✅ Python $PYTHON_VERSION found"
    PYTHON_CMD="python3"
elif command_exists python; then
    PYTHON_VERSION=$(python --version 2>&1 | cut -d' ' -f2)
    echo "✅ Python $PYTHON_VERSION found"
    PYTHON_CMD="python"
else
    echo "❌ Python not found. Please install Python 3.10+"
    exit 1
fi

# Install pip if missing
echo "📦 Checking pip..."
if ! $PYTHON_CMD -m pip --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Installing pip..."
    curl https://bootstrap.pypa.io/get-pip.py -o get-pip.py
    $PYTHON_CMD get-pip.py
    rm get-pip.py
fi

# Upgrade pip
echo "⬆️  Upgrading pip..."
$PYTHON_CMD -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

# Install system dependencies for CV2
echo "🖼️  Installing system dependencies for OpenCV..."
if command_exists apt-get; then
    # Ubuntu/Debian
    sudo apt-get update
    sudo apt-get install -y \
        python3-opencv \
        libgl1-mesa-glx \
        libglib2.0-0 \
        libsm6 \
        libxext6 \
        libxrender-dev \
        libgomp1 \
        ffmpeg
elif command_exists yum; then
    # RHEL/CentOS
    sudo yum install -y \
        opencv-python \
        mesa-libGL \
        glib2 \
        libSM \
        libXext \
        libXrender \
        libgomp \
        ffmpeg
elif command_exists brew; then
    # macOS
    brew install opencv ffmpeg
else
    echo "⚠️  Please install OpenCV system dependencies manually"
fi

# Install PyTorch with CUDA support (if available)
echo "🔥 Installing PyTorch..."
if command_exists nvidia-smi; then
    echo "🚀 NVIDIA GPU detected, installing CUDA version..."
    $PYTHON_CMD -m pip install torch torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu118
else
    echo "💻 Installing CPU-only version..."
    $PYTHON_CMD -m pip install torch torchvision torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
fi

# Install core dependencies
echo "📚 Installing core dependencies..."
$PYTHON_CMD -m pip install \
    fastapi \
    uvicorn[standard] \
    transformers \
    diffusers \
    openai \
    anthropic \
    opencv-python \
    opencv-contrib-python \
    openai-whisper \
    librosa \
    streamlit \
    websockets \
    sqlalchemy \
    requests \
    pandas \
    numpy \
    pillow \
    python-dotenv \
    pydantic

# Install Ollama (optional)
echo "🦙 Installing Ollama (optional)..."
if ! command_exists ollama; then
    curl -fsSL https://ollama.ai/install.sh | sh
    echo "✅ Ollama installed. Run 'ollama pull llama2' to download a model."
else
    echo "✅ Ollama already installed"
fi

# Create necessary directories
echo "📁 Creating directories..."
mkdir -p data logs storage

# Set up environment file
echo "⚙️  Setting up environment..."
if [ ! -f .env ]; then
    cat > .env << EOL
# SymbioCoder Environment Configuration
# Copy your API keys here (optional - local models work without them)

# AI Provider API Keys (optional)
OPENAI_API_KEY=your_openai_api_key_here
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your_anthropic_api_key_here
GOOGLE_API_KEY=your_google_api_key_here
HF_API_TOKEN=your_huggingface_token_here

# Default Settings
SYM_DEFAULT_STT=whisper_local
SYM_STORAGE=./storage
OLLAMA_URL=http://localhost:11434

# Database
DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./symbiocoder.db
EOL
    echo "✅ Environment file created (.env)"
fi

echo ""
echo "🎉 Dependency installation complete!"
echo ""
echo "🚀 Next steps:"
echo "1. Run: python backend/onboarding.py setup"
echo "2. Start backend: python backend/symbio-coder.py"  
echo "3. Start UI: streamlit run backend/streamlit-app.py"
echo ""
echo "💡 For Docker: docker-compose up -d"
echo "🔧 For issues: Check logs in ./logs directory"

```

#!/bin/bash
# ============================================================================
# Repository to Markdown Converter
# Converts entire repository into a single markdown file for LLM collaboration
# ============================================================================

# Configuration
OUTPUT_DIR="exports"
OUTPUT_FILE="${OUTPUT_DIR}/repo-snapshot-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).md"
REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

# Colors for output
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Files and directories to ignore (add more as needed)
IGNORE_PATTERNS=(
  "node_modules"
  ".next"
  ".git"
  ".pytest_cache"
  "__pycache__"
  ".venv"
  "venv"
  ".env"
  ".env.local"
  ".env.production"
  "dist"
  "build"
  "coverage"
  ".cache"
  ".vercel"
  "*.pyc"
  "*.pyo"
  "*.pyd"
  ".DS_Store"
  "*.log"
  "logs"
  "*.sqlite"
  "*.db"
  ".snapshots"
  ".vscode"
  ".devcontainer"
  "exports"
  "*.min.js"
  "*.min.css"
  "*.map"
  "package-lock.json"
  "tsconfig.tsbuildinfo"
  ".gitignore"
  "*.jpg"
  "*.jpeg"
  "*.png"
  "*.gif"
  "*.ico"
  "*.svg"
  "*.woff"
  "*.woff2"
  "*.ttf"
  "*.eot"
)

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

# Function to check if file should be ignored
should_ignore() {
  local file="$1"
  
  for pattern in "${IGNORE_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
    if [[ "$file" == *"$pattern"* ]]; then
      return 0  # true, should ignore
    fi
  done
  
  return 1  # false, should not ignore
}

# Function to get file extension for syntax highlighting
get_language() {
  local file="$1"
  local ext="${file##*.}"
  
  case "$ext" in
    js) echo "javascript" ;;
    jsx) echo "javascript" ;;
    ts) echo "typescript" ;;
    tsx) echo "typescript" ;;
    py) echo "python" ;;
    sh) echo "bash" ;;
    yml|yaml) echo "yaml" ;;
    json) echo "json" ;;
    md) echo "markdown" ;;
    css) echo "css" ;;
    scss) echo "scss" ;;
    html) echo "html" ;;
    sql) echo "sql" ;;
    env) echo "bash" ;;
    txt) echo "text" ;;
    *) echo "" ;;
  esac
}

# Function to check if file is text-based
is_text_file() {
  local file="$1"
  file -b --mime-type "$file" | grep -q '^text/'
}

echo -e "${BLUE}🚀 Repository to Markdown Converter${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}====================================${NC}\n"

# Start writing to output file
cat > "$OUTPUT_FILE" << 'EOF'
# Repository Snapshot

> Generated for LLM collaboration and documentation purposes

## Table of Contents

- [Project Overview](#project-overview)
- [Repository Structure](#repository-structure)
- [File Contents](#file-contents)

---

## Project Overview

**Repository:** Resume Rockstar
**Generated:** 
EOF

echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
echo "" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"

# Add repository structure
echo -e "${YELLOW}📁 Analyzing repository structure...${NC}"

cat >> "$OUTPUT_FILE" << 'EOF'

## Repository Structure

```
EOF

# Generate tree structure (excluding ignored patterns)
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
tree_ignore_args=""
for pattern in "${IGNORE_PATTERNS[@]}"; do
  tree_ignore_args="$tree_ignore_args -I '$pattern'"
done

# Use tree if available, otherwise use find
if command -v tree &> /dev/null; then
  eval "tree -L 4 $tree_ignore_args" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
else
  find . -type d \( -name node_modules -o -name .git -o -name .next -o -name __pycache__ \) -prune -o -print | head -n 200 >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
fi

cat >> "$OUTPUT_FILE" << 'EOF'
```

---

## File Contents

EOF

# Counter for progress
file_count=0
total_size=0

echo -e "${YELLOW}📝 Processing files...${NC}\n"

# Find all text files and add them to markdown
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
  # Skip if should be ignored
  if should_ignore "$file"; then
    continue
  fi
  
  # Get relative path
  rel_path="${file#$REPO_ROOT/}"
  
  # Skip if starts with . (hidden files)
  if [[ "$rel_path" == .* ]]; then
    continue
  fi
  
  # Check if it's a text file
  if is_text_file "$file"; then
    # Get language for syntax highlighting
    lang=$(get_language "$file")
    
    # Get file size
    file_size=$(wc -c < "$file")
    total_size=$((total_size + file_size))
    
    # Skip very large files (>1MB)
    if [ "$file_size" -gt 1048576 ]; then
      echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠️  Skipping large file: $rel_path ($(numfmt --to=iec-i --suffix=B $file_size))${NC}"
      continue
    fi
    
    echo -e "${GREEN}✓${NC} Adding: $rel_path"
    
    # Add file to markdown
    cat >> "$OUTPUT_FILE" << EOF

### \`$rel_path\`

\`\`\`$lang
EOF
    cat "$file" >> "$OUTPUT_FILE"
    cat >> "$OUTPUT_FILE" << 'EOF'
```

---

## Summary

## 🚀 Quick Setup Commands

```bash
# 1. Extract and enter directory
unzip SymbioCoder-Plus-Release-v1.0.zip
cd SymbioCoder-Plus-Release-v1.0

# 2. Run setup (auto-detects OS)  
./scripts/setup.sh        # Linux/macOS
scripts\setup.bat         # Windows

# 3. Start development servers
npm run dev               # Starts both frontend & backend

# 4. Access the application
open http://localhost:3000  # Frontend (Next.js)
open http://localhost:8000  # Backend API (FastAPI)
```

## 🎯 Key Integration Points

### Neural Aurora Theme Integration
- **Frontend**: Applied via `frontend/app/globals.css` with CSS variables
- **Components**: Styled using Tailwind classes with Neural Aurora palette
- **Branding**: GestaltView logo integration in header/navigation

### AI Provider Architecture  
- **Router**: `integrations/llm_router.py` handles provider fallback
- **Adapters**: Individual `*_adapter.py` files for each AI service
- **Config**: Provider settings in `backend/providers.json`

### Authentication & Security
- **JWT**: Implemented in `backend/app.py` with secure session management
- **Hooks**: Frontend auth state managed via `frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts`
- **WebSocket**: Real-time communication through `useWebSocket.ts`

### Development Experience
- **Scripts**: Automated setup and deployment in `scripts/` folder
- **Testing**: Comprehensive test suite in `tests/` folder
- **Docs**: Extensive documentation in `docs/` folder
- **VS Code**: Optimized configuration in `.vscode/` folder

# SymbioCoder

[![License: SCL](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-SCL-yellow.svg)](Docs/LICENSE.md)
[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-blue.svg)](Frontend/package.json)

> **Your AI Coding Symbiote** - Consciousness-serving AI platform for collaborative coding

SymbioCoder is a revolutionary AI coding assistant built by Keith Soyka as a focused implementation of the GestaltView platform. It embodies a new paradigm of AI-human symbiosis—empowering human creativity with adaptive, privacy-first, multi-provider AI support.

## 🚀 Quick Start
1. Extract the ZIP package:
unzip SymbioCoder-v1.0.zip

cd SymbioCoder-v1.0

3. Run the setup wizard:
python backend/onboarding.py setup

4. Start the backend:
python backend/symbio-coder.py

5. Start the Streamlit UI (in another terminal):
streamlit run frontend/streamlit-app.py

6. Optional: Start Next.js frontend:
cd frontend

npm install

npm run dev

Open your browser:
- **Streamlit UI**: http://localhost:8501
- **Next.js UI**: http://localhost:3000  
- **API Docs**: http://localhost:8000/docs

## 🛠️ Installation Guide

### Method 1: Automated Setup (Recommended)
```bash
# Run the interactive setup wizard
python backend/onboarding.py setup --mode=beginner
```

The wizard will:
- ✅ Check system requirements
- 🔧 Configure environment variables
- 📦 Install Python dependencies
- 🤖 Download starter AI models
- 🔒 Set up authentication
- ✨ Test all components

### Method 2: Manual Setup
```bash
1. Install Python dependencies
pip install -r backend/requirements.txt

2. Configure environment
cp extras/.env.example .env

Edit .env with your API keys (optional)
3. Set up providers
cp backend/providers.json providers.json

Edit priorities and model preferences
4. Initialize database
python backend/symbio-coder.py --init-db

5. Start services
python backend/symbio-coder.py &
streamlit run backend/.streamlit/streamlit-app.py
```

### Method 3: Docker Deployment
```bash
# Quick start with Docker Compose
docker-compose up -d

# Or build from scratch
docker build -f dockers/Dockerfile-base -t symbiocoder .
docker run -p 8000:8000 -p 8501:8501 symbiocoder
```

### Environment Variables (.env)
```bash
# Example environment variables for SymbioCoder
SYM_DEFAULT_STT=whisper_local
SYM_STORAGE=./storage
SYM_LLM_PRIORITY=ollama,openai,hf,local_stub
OPENAI_API_KEY=
HF_API_TOKEN=
HF_MODEL=mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2
GOOGLE_API_KEY=
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=
ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY=
VIBE_API_KEY=

# Security
SECRET_KEY=your-secret-key-change-in-production
SESSION_TIMEOUT=86400

# Database
DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./symbiocoder.db
```

### Provider Configuration (providers.json)
```json
{
  "ollama": {
    "notes": "Local-first. Set OLLAMA_URL or install ollama CLI."
  },
  "openai": {
    "notes": "Set OPENAI_API_KEY. Use gpt-4o/gpt-4o-mini as preferred models."
  },
  "gemini": {

  },
  "anthropic": {
    "notes": "Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for Claude integration."
  },
  "hf": {
    "notes": "Set HF_API_TOKEN and optional HF_MODEL (Mistral/Qwen/Phi/DeepSeek)."
  },
  "vibe": {
    "notes": "Set VIBE_API_KEY and VIBE_API_URL for cloud TTS."
  }
}
```

BACKEND_URL = "http://localhost:8000"
```

│  (Port 3000)   │    │  (Port 8501)    │    │   (Future)      │
└─────────┬───────┘    └─────────┬───────┘    └─────────┬───────┘
          │                      │                      │
          └──────────────────────┼──────────────────────┘
                                 │
                  ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                  │         FastAPI Backend          │
                  │         (Port 8000)             │
                  │                                 │
                  │  ┌─────────┐  ┌─────────────┐   │
                  │  │   API   │  │  WebSocket  │   │
                  │  │ Router  │  │   Handler   │   │
                  │  └─────────┘  └─────────────┘   │
                  │                                 │
                  │  ┌─────────────────────────────┐ │
                  │  │      AI Provider Layer      │ │
                  │  │                             │ │
                  │  │ OpenAI → Anthropic → HF →   │ │
                  │  │ Ollama → Local Fallback     │ │
                  │  └─────────────────────────────┘ │
                  └─────────────────┬───────────────┘
                                    │
                      ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                      │         Data Layer              │
                      │                                 │
                      │  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐    │
                      │  │ SQLite   │  │  Redis   │    │
                      │  │   DB     │  │ (Optional)│    │
                      │  └──────────┘  └──────────┘    │
                      └─────────────────────────────────┘
```
# Architecture Diagram — SymbioCoder

```
flowchart LR
  subgraph Frontend
    A[Next.js/React] -->|HTTP/WS| B[Backend API (FastAPI)]
    C[Streamlit] -->|HTTP| B
  end
  subgraph Backend
    B --> D[GestaltView Integrations]
    D --> E{Providers}
    E --> E1[Ollama (local)]
    E --> E2[OpenAI]
    E --> E3[Google Gemini]
    E --> E4[Anthropic]
    E --> E5[HuggingFace Inference]
    E --> E6[Local Fallbacks (Whisper/llama.cpp)]
  end
  B --> F[Storage (filesystem / S3)]
  B --> G[Database (SQLite/Postgres)]
```

ASCII overview:
```
frontend/   -> Next.js + Streamlit (UI)
backend/    -> FastAPI (upload, download, collaborate, auth)
GestaltView -> integrations (ollama, openai, gemini, anthropic, hf, vibe, stt)
storage/    -> uploads, media files (local or S3)
db/         -> symbiocoder.db (sqlite) or Postgres for production
```

## 🔧 Troubleshooting

### Common Issues

#### Backend Won't Start
```bash
# Check Python version
python --version  # Should be 3.10+

# Check dependencies
pip install -r backend/requirements.txt

# Check port availability
lsof -i :8000
```

#### No AI Providers Available
```bash
# Check API keys
python -c "import os; print('OpenAI:', bool(os.getenv('OPENAI_API_KEY')))"

# Test Ollama connection
curl http://localhost:11434/api/version

# Validate providers.json
python -c "import json; print(json.load(open('providers.json')))"
```

#### Database Errors
```bash
# Reset database
rm symbiocoder.db
python backend/symbio-coder.py --init-db

# Check database integrity
sqlite3 symbiocoder.db ".schema"
```

#### Frontend Build Issues
```bash
# Clear Next.js cache
cd frontend
rm -rf .next node_modules package-lock.json
npm install
npm run build
```

### Getting Help

1. **Check the logs**: All components log to console with detailed error messages
2. **Run health checks**: Use `python backend/onboarding.py health`
3. **Validate setup**: Use `python backend/onboarding.py validate`
4. **Reset if needed**: Delete `.env`, `providers.json`, and `symbiocoder.db` to start fresh

## 🔒 Security & Privacy

SymbioCoder is designed with privacy and security as core principles:

- **Local-First**: Can run entirely offline with local AI models
- **Data Control**: All user data stored locally by default
- **Optional Cloud**: API providers used only when you configure them
- **Transparent AI**: Shows which provider generated each response
- **Secure Auth**: JWT-based authentication with secure session management
- **No Telemetry**: No usage tracking or data collection by default

## 💡 Philosophy: Consciousness-Serving AI

SymbioCoder embodies the GestaltView philosophy of consciousness-serving AI:

- **Amplification, Not Replacement**: AI enhances human creativity rather than replacing it
- **Symbiotic Relationship**: Equal partnership between human intuition and AI capability
- **Respect for Consciousness**: AI adapts to human cognitive patterns and needs
- **Ethical Foundation**: Built on principles of empowerment, not exploitation
- **Individual Sovereignty**: You maintain complete control over your tools and data

## tools/import_export.py
```
"""import_export.py
Utilities to export/import user profiles and conversation history as JSON.
Provides:
  - export_user(user_id, out_path)
  - import_user(json_path)
"""
import json, sqlite3, os
DB = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', 'symbiocoder.db')
def get_conn():
    return sqlite3.connect(DB)
def export_user(user_id, out_path):
    conn = get_conn()
    c = conn.cursor()
    user = c.execute('SELECT id, username, created_at FROM users WHERE id=?', (user_id,)).fetchone()
    profile = c.execute('SELECT data FROM profiles WHERE user_id=?', (user_id,)).fetchone()
    convs = c.execute('SELECT role, message, timestamp FROM conversations WHERE user_id=? ORDER BY id', (user_id,)).fetchall()
    conn.close()
    if not user:
        raise ValueError("User not found")
    payload = {
        "user": {"id": user[0], "username": user[1], "created_at": user[2]},
        "profile": json.loads(profile[0]) if profile and profile[0] else {},
        "conversations": [{"role": r, "message": m, "timestamp": t} for (r,m,t) in convs]
    }
    with open(out_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(payload, f, indent=2)
    print("Exported user", user_id, "->", out_path)
def import_user(json_path):
    with open(json_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        payload = json.load(f)
    conn = get_conn()
    c = conn.cursor()
    user = payload.get("user", {})
    c.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO users (id, username) VALUES (?,?)', (user.get("id"), user.get("username")))
    profile = payload.get("profile", {})
    c.execute('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO profiles (user_id, data) VALUES (?,?)', (user.get("id"), json.dumps(profile)))
    for conv in payload.get("conversations", []):
        c.execute('INSERT INTO conversations (user_id, role, message, timestamp) VALUES (?,?,?,?)',
                  (user.get("id"), conv.get("role"), conv.get("message"), conv.get("timestamp")))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    print("Imported data from", json_path)

```

## tools/deploy.py
```
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Simple deployment script for SymbioCoder
"""

import subprocess
import argparse
import platform

def deploy(mode='local'):
    if mode == 'local':
        setup_script = "Scripts/setup.bat" if platform.system() == "Windows" else "Scripts/setup.sh"
        try:
            result = subprocess.run([setup_script], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
            if result.returncode != 0:
                print(f"❌ Setup failed: {result.stderr}")
                return
            subprocess.run(["python", "Backend/symbio-coder.py"], check=True)
            subprocess.run(["streamlit", "run", "Backend/streamlit-app.py"], check=True)
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
            print(f"❌ Deployment error: {e.stderr}")
    elif mode == 'docker':
        try:
            subprocess.run(["docker-compose", "up", "-d"], check=True)
        except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
            print(f"❌ Docker deployment failed: {e.stderr}")
    else:
        print(f"Unknown mode: {mode}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--mode", default="local", choices=["local", "docker"])
    args = parser.parse_args()
    deploy(args.mode)

```

Voice-to-Text Integration Notes
------------------------------
For production-quality STT, you have options:
1) Local: install `pip install SpeechRecognition` plus a suitable audio backend (pyaudio or sounddevice).
   - On Linux: pip install SpeechRecognition pyaudio
   - On macOS: brew install portaudio && pip install pyaudio
2) Cloud providers: Google Cloud Speech-to-Text, AssemblyAI, OpenAI Whisper (via APIs or local), Deepgram.
   - These require API keys and slightly different integration code; prefer sending audio as WAV or FLAC.
3) Ollama/local LLMs: perform transcription using local models if you run Whisper or other models locally.
The included `voice_to_text.py` is a friendly shim that will switch to real transcribers when dependencies are installed.
